item.title: 3 charged in Christmas Eve murder conspiracy, including ADOC inmate accused of orchestrating plot
item.description: The Madison Police Department said three people were charged in a murder conspiracy that was orchestrated from inside a maximum security Alabama prison.

item.title: Toyota Field, Trash Pandas Mascot Sprocket up for USA Today 10Best Honors
item.description: Fans of the Rocket City Trash Pandas have a chance to show their hometown pride by voting for two local favorites in the annual USA Today 10Best Readers' Choice Awards.

item.title: Gov. Ivey signs bill requiring English proficiency for truck drivers in Alabama
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey has signed Senate Bill 242 into law, establishing new requirements for commercial truck drivers operating in Alabama to demonstrate English language proficiency.

item.title: Man identified after police chase ends with shooting in Rainsville
item.description: A person was injured in a shooting after leading law enforcement on a police chase in Rainsville on Tuesday.

item.title: No gun found on campus following report by student, lockdown at Danville Middle School
item.description: A spokesperson for Morgan County Schools said Danville Middle was placed on lockdown after a report that there was a gun on campus but has since returned to normal operations.

item.title: ROTC students at Old Dominion University subdued and killed shooter who left 1 dead, 2 hurt
item.description: A former Army National Guard member who had spent eight years in prison for attempting to aid the Islamic State opened fire on a classroom at Virginia's Old Dominion University on Thursday before ROTC students subdued and killed him, authorities said. item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen from Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: An attacker armed with a rifle rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest reform synagogues Thursday, driving through a hallway as security opened fire, fatally shooting him, authorities said.

item.title: 7th-grade student arrested for trying to bring gun into Buckhorn Middle School
item.description: A student was taken into custody after trying to bring a gun into Buckhorn Middle School on Thursday.
